alliance_war.home_castle_loss: captured if adjacent; losing alliance becomes displaced and receives nearest neutral relocation home after 12h; season continues
alliance_war.lane_resolution: 10 deterministic lane battles; 1 point per lane

home_castle.special: starting stronghold; can be captured only by adjacent enemy territory

alliance_war.snapshot_lock_rule: At roster lock, the complete combat snapshot is frozen; purchases/upgrades after lock do not alter that war.

alliance_war.tie_break: if 5-5, higher sum of normalized victory margins wins

army_visual_progression.goal: By late campaign the scene must read as a truly enormous army, not six icons behind the hero.
army_visual_progression.monster_scale_rule: normal waves increase enemy count; elites use larger models; region bosses are giant focal enemies with minions where appropriate
army_visual_progression.mythic_render_rule: render 1-3 hero-scale mythic representatives per deployed mythic stack plus distant silhouettes; never spawn thousands of full-cost mythic models

art_direction.style: premium medieval fantasy, noble, cinematic, realistic 2.5D

economy_invariants: No Hero level requires Gold; XP is the only Hero level gate.
First-clear campaign XP alone cannot reach level 100; repeat/offline/events remain meaningful.
Every normal kill contributes XP/Gold/resource progress; gear is less frequent to avoid inventory flooding.
Forge never fails and is slot-based so replacing gear never destroys prior upgrade investment.
Late Castle/Research costs require a mix of production, battle farming, Domain bonuses, quests/events and time.
Paid acceleration never modifies a locked Alliance War snapshot.

target_f2p_pacing.campaign_200: roughly weeks 3-6 depending on optimization; telemetry may motivate v1.2 tuning

battle.combat_animation: server resolves deterministic outcome/rewards; client animates hero, representative army cohorts and monster hordes from the authoritative result

difficulty_ramp.note: v1.2 progressive late-game difficulty: +20% at 100, +40% at 150, +60% at 200

battle.failure_rule: failed stage gives 20% of kill-earned XP/Gold already escrowed but no clear bonus, domain tile or boss chest

counters.pve_rule: unit_power *= 1 + sum(mix_share[class] * (bonus_pct if class in strong_vs else -malus_pct if class in weak_vs else 0))/100; mix = stage enemy classes
counters.war_rule: per lane, each side's per-unit army power is multiplied against the opponent's deployed army class mix (share = command_cost*quantity); NPC defenders are neutral

units.formation_representation: squad icon/formation; do not render every owned soldier
units.formation_rule: Lord is always present; deploy up to the unlocked formation-type slots without exceeding command capacity
units.ownership: recruited quantities persist; no permanent PvE or Alliance War death in v1.1
units.visualization: cohort virtualization; backend stores real quantities, client renders representative troops plus layered background cohorts

ux.battle_primary CTA: Auto battle always runs while Battle screen is active; player manages gear, skills, army formation and progression between attempts.
